implementation_summary: Added analyseSite(input: AnalysisInput): Promise<SiteAnalysis>. Its input type is its own (no crawl import): origin, startPath, pages {urlPath, depth, raw, content}, statusByPath, skippedPaths, accessibility (AccessibilityBasicsResult & {urlPath}), fetch, optional maxLinkRequests and headers, firstFindingNumber. Steps: pages are de-duplicated by path (first wins); detectTechnology, buildPageHierarchy and internalLinking run; contentProblems and checkLinks run on a scratch id series. Findings are ordered content, links, then accessibility in page order. Repeats of the same rule+page+target are dropped and final AF-NNN ids are assigned from firstFindingNumber. Accessibility basics findingIds are remapped to the final ids and violations is recomputed. seoBasics and marketingSignals/auditMarketing are built from the final findings. Output: technology, hierarchy, internalLinking, pages {urlPath,title,depth,language,sections(SectionSummary),seo,accessibility?}, findings, marketing, nextFindingNumber, notes. The barrel index.ts exports every listed function and type plus option and result types, CONTENT_PROBLEM_RULES, READ_PAGE_MAX_TEXT_CHARS, formatFindingId and ANALYSIS_MAX_LINK_REQUESTS.
tests_proposed: Integration test feeding real readPage output from the fixture site into analyseSite (needs Chromium; belongs with the G2 crawl wiring).
risks: Contract: analyseSite is async (Promise<SiteAnalysis>), not the sync signature in the task text, because checkLinks is async.
Contract: AnalysisInput has a required 'origin' (needed by checkLinks) and optional maxLinkRequests (default ANALYSIS_MAX_LINK_REQUESTS = 100) and headers; not listed in the task text.
Dedupe key is rule + urlPath + target. Two missing-alt images with the same src on one page become one finding, and two axe findings of the same rule with no CSS selector on one page also collapse.
Accessibility basics: violations is recomputed as the number of distinct final ids after the duplicate drop, so it can be lower than the checker's count.
Accessibility results for paths not in the recorded pages are dropped silently.

The barrel exports accessibilityBasics, which imports @qa/checkers as a value. Importing the barrel therefore loads the checkers package (core only, no runner or wizard; checked by a static import-graph test).
handoff: Callers: await analyseSite({ origin, startPath, pages, statusByPath, skippedPaths, accessibility, fetch: makeOutboundFetch(...), firstFindingNumber }). Put 'http-error' skips in statusByPath, not skippedPaths. Pass accessibility results as returned by accessibilityBasics with urlPath added; their ids are renumbered, so any allocator works. Hand nextFindingNumber to the G4 AI findings. Show notes. SiteAnalysis.pages entries are a subset of AuditPage (add coverage, layoutGroup, phone, speed and so on later). BE-190: re-export packages/core/src/audit/analysis/index.ts from the core barrel. No name clashes with the current core index.ts were found for the exported names.
